constraints: dstVar cannot be a local variable; it must be a process/interprocess variable of the destination process, or an element of such an array (arrays as a whole and pointers are not accepted as destination variables — use VARIABLE TO VARIABLE to write a whole array, or SET PROCESS VARIABLE only for a single element).
Writing the element of an array of pointers or of a two-dimensional array is not supported.
Each expr must be of a type compatible with its paired dstVar, otherwise the destination variable may end up with a meaningless value.
In interpreted mode, if a destination variable does not already exist it is created and assigned the expression's value; the destination process is never notified that its variable was written.
The destination process must be a user process, not a kernel process; if it does not exist, an error is generated (catchable with ON ERR CALL).

From a 4D Client, pass a negative value in process to write interprocess variables of the 4D Server machine (prefixing the process ID with a minus sign targets that stored procedure specifically); this communication direction only works from client to server.
